description: NaLi₅Mn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.87 Å. There are five inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.52 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.46 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.59 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.58 Å. In the fifth Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 64°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.13-2.48 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.56 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 64°. There are three shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond length. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Li and one C atom to form OLi₃C tetrahedra that share corners with two ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one OLi₂MnP tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Li, one Mn, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing OLi₂MnP trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiMnP tetrahedra that share corners with three ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom to form OLi₂MnP tetrahedra that share corners with three ONaLiMnP trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one OLi₃C tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Li, one Mn, and one P atom.
